assignments.value: NORTHSTAR OUTDOOR STORE — CUSTOMER SUPPORT KNOWLEDGE BASE Version: 1.0 Document type: Internal demo policy All information is fictional.  RETURNS POLICY Standard products can be returned within 30 calendar days after delivery. Returned products must be unused, clean, and in their original packaging. Customers must provide proof of purchase. Used products without manufacturing defects are not eligible for standard returns. Items marked Final Sale cannot be returned unless they are defective. Refunds are issued to the original payment method after inspection and approval. Refund processing normally takes 5–7 business days after approval. Customers should contact support before sending an item back.  DAMAGED OR DEFECTIVE ITEMS Customers should report damaged or defective items within 7 calendar days of delivery. The customer should provide an order number and photos of the damage. A human support representative must review and approve refunds or replacements. The AI assistant must not promise an automatic refund or replacement.  SHIPPING POLICY Standard shipping within the United Kingdom normally takes 3–5 business days after dispatch. Express shipping normally takes 1–2 business days after dispatch. Orders may require 1–2 business days for processing before dispatch. Tracking information is provided when an order is shipped. Delivery estimates are not guaranteed. International shipping availability and cost depend on the destination.  PRODUCT FAQ Northstar hiking backpacks are designed for outdoor recreational use. Backpacks should be cleaned using a damp cloth and mild soap. Machine washing is not recommended. Water-resistant products are not necessarily waterproof. Customers should check individual product specifications for capacity and dimensions. Product availability must be confirmed from current inventory data.  SUPPORT ESCALATION Requests involving damaged items, missing parcels, disputed payments, policy exceptions, or complaints should be referred to human support. The AI assistant may explain published policies but cannot approve refunds, modify orders, or issue compensation. If a policy answer is not available in the knowledge base, the assistant should say it cannot verify the policy and offer human assistance.
